text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: This is great! Check out the stands—everybody's going wild!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Loads of folks called out to me on the way here. Reckon they're expecting me to do well.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I really can't lose now! My heart's about to burst with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll beat Suzuka and everybody else. And after that, I'm gonna clinch the rest of the G1 sprints too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh… you're lookin' a tad nervous, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well, turn that frown upside down!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Que sera sera. Whatever happens happens.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Or rather, whatever I want to happen happens!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Next stop, the finish line! Just take it easy and wait for me there, Trainer!
